items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I could understand the old man better than his own son, man.

ctx.x: Who's the people you said used to go eat dinner at Lycanna's? Some of them.

Oh, well, that was a big shot. It was after. The best, man. Next to my house, Mr. Lycanna, man. If I was saying the wrong thing, I would say because it was being taped, see. I'd have to stick myself. So, Mr. Joe and I, Mr. Lloyd Cannon, the old man, Lloyd Cannon. I worked with good buddies, you know. I could understand the old man better than his own son, man. He was getting mad at Steve. It was a big shot. He was going on the tape, singing the theater, you know. Mr. Joe said, come on, Salvatore. Go in the back,…
He did that when he started.
